profile.headline: Front End Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a self-driven software engineer who is passionate about mobile and web development. I work best in a fast paced environment that will not only challenge my skills as an engineer, but also enhance my abilities as a leader. While I thrive equally in an independent and team-based environment, I am capable of delivering software in large or small teams.

Github: https://github.com/AndersonNguyen1
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/c/AndersonNguyen1
Email: andersonvannguyen@gmail.com
CodeEval: https://www.codeeval.com/profile/AndersonNguyen1/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed a data pipeline in Python that analyzes user’s sleep data and generates visual graphs in Jupyter Notebook using Panda and Numpy.
• Orchestrated Figma mockups for Somnology’s mobile app, SomnoRing, that includes over 30+ interactive frames.
• Revamped the legacy SomnoRing app to Swift, which includes all of the main Figma pages, interactions, and stores user information onto the AWS Cloud platform.
• Integrated MEGAring SDK into SomnoRing app, allowing users to connect to the physical SomnoRing device and report their sleep data to the AWS Cloud platform.
• Managed the company’s existing WordPress website by updating the UI, designing Somnology’s company logo, maintaining the servers, and adding a new glossary page using the Glossary - WordPress plugin.

positions.title: Front Desk Attendant at Middle Earth Housing
positions.description:
• Welcomed 10000+ freshman residents and parents to UCI by providing general information about Middle Earth Housing.
• Coordinated with peers and faculty to ensure smooth operations of the housing office, mailroom system, and student amenities.
• Managed student profiles in the internal system and processed their packages.

positions.title: Front Desk at the ARC (Anteater Recreation Center)
positions.description:
• Provided general information about the ARC to UCI affiliated patrons and rented out sports equipment at the front desk.
• Sold memberships, guest passes, food, and drinks to ARC patrons using specialized software that the ARC owns.
• Rented out sporting equipment to ARC patrons, managed lost and found, and received phone calls to answer questions.

positions.title: Team Leader
positions.description:
• Taught and supervised science, art, and physical education classes through weekly projects based on a curriculum for summer camp students.
• Developed better time management and leadership skills through working with student campers and collaborating with fellow Team Leaders on daily agendas.

projects.title: BlueStamp Engineering - Raspberry Pi Camera
projects.description: BSE is a highly selective engineering program where students spend six weeks working on projects of their choice. We become our own teachers and the instructors act as our mentors.
